UP se aake gori pura Bihar hilawelu

Coming from UP, girl, you shake up the whole of Bihar.

Chain kho gayil aur karar kho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar hogayi

UP wali laiki se pyar ho gayil

I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.

I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.

2 go bodyguard rakhelu ghar ke bahar pehra tohar

Tu pajara hamra aawa
Ab hamke tadpawa
Tu pajara hamra aawa

Now don't keep me longing for you.
Come close to me.
Now don't keep me longing for you.
Come close to me.

Ratiya ke neendiyan haram ho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar ho gayil

My night's sleep has been ruined.
I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.

Tohra ke bana ke rakhab ham rani rani
Rangdar jila patna ke bani rani
Ek beri hamro batiya mani rani
Nishant ke kai dehlu tu pani pani

I will keep you like a queen, my queen.
I am a tough guy from the district of Patna, my queen.
Just listen to me once, my queen.
You have left Nishant completely overwhelmed.

---

Outro
Bat suna dher intezar ho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar hogayil
Hamke pyar hogayil
Hamke pyar ho gayil
Hamke pyar hogayil

I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.
I've fallen in love.

I've fallen in love.
